title: Code Review Feedback Discussion
situation: You need to discuss a recent pull request with a junior developer, providing constructive feedback on their implementation while ensuring project deadlines are met.
sentence_template: Hello, I have {blank_1} regarding your recent pull request. Could we schedule a chat to {blank_2} and aim to {blank_3}?

options.text: some notes on the code structure
go through a few optimisation ideas
merge the updates by Friday afternoon

o1.why: This clearly and politely indicates the focus of the feedback without sounding overly critical.

o2.why: This frames the discussion collaboratively, encouraging shared problem-solving.

o3.why: This sets a clear, actionable target for completing the task together.

o4.what_to_improve: Be more specific about what needs attention rather than using vague urgency.
o4.why: Phrases like 'fix everything quickly' can feel overwhelming and lack actionable detail.

o5.what_to_improve: Propose targeted improvements rather than suggesting a total rewrite.
o5.why: Suggesting a complete rewrite can demoralise team members and is rarely necessary for code refinement.

guidance: Consider how your phrasing impacts collaboration and clarity when reviewing junior team members' code.
